archetypes.name: dyn-progress-step0
archetypes.rationale: Step 0 run pointer ordering is the main risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 0 changes that activate the progress pointer after session setup. Check that parsed run ids and SESSION_ID fallback are selected correctly, repo_root matches write-design-env, and timing breadcrumbs cannot land before activation. Verify activation remains best-effort and does not alter degraded-tools gate behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
